response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with exposure to AI-agent workflows and cloud technologies, aligning well with the Staff Forward Deployed Engineer role. However, his AI-specific experience is less explicit than required, and his leadership in AI-driven solutions is not fully evidenced in the resume.
strengths: Extensive experience with TypeScript, Python-adjacent languages (DLang), and cloud platforms (AWS), meeting core technical requirements.
Proven track record in leading technical projects, mentoring teams, and driving engineering excellence, fitting the staff-level seniority.
Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic workflows at re:cinq, demonstrating direct relevance to GenAI systems.
concerns: Limited explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions; most AI-related work appears recent or tangential.
No clear mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM performance optimization, which are critical for the role.
Lacks a Master's/PhD in AI/CS, though this is a preferred qualification and not strictly required.
